installId.description: Random install id, no account needed.

capturedAt.description: ISO time the event happened in-game.

level.description: The NPC's level. Absent when the source did not record it, as in a converted Polestar Recorder file.

reaction.description: How the NPC stood toward the player. Absent when the source did not record it, as in a converted Polestar Recorder file.

positionKind.description: Whose coordinates were measured; legacy unknown positions never become spawn pins. `interaction` is the player's position while the NPC's window was open, a few yards from the NPC. `vignette` is the NPC's own position, as the game's vignette API gave it for a rare on the minimap.

role.description: With `interaction`: the window that opened (`NPC_ROLES`). Absent for a gossip window that names no service and from older addons.

creatureType.description: The creature type the game shows, as `UnitCreatureType` reports it in English. Older addons send none.

rank.description: `UnitClassification`: normal, elite, rare, rare_elite or boss (`worldboss`). Older addons send none.

installId.description: Random install id, no account needed.

capturedAt.description: ISO time the event happened in-game.

sourceItemId.description: The item that was disenchanted or opened (a lockbox, a clam, a bag). Older addons send none.

lootType.description: What opened the window, from the spell cast just before it (`LOOT_TYPES`). Absent on windows from older addons and converted Recorder files; those are never sorted into a type by guessing.

copper.description: The coin in the window, in copper. Absent when the window held none or the addon could not read it.

sourceEvidence.description: Legacy target guesses are withheld from public loot observations.

mapId.description: With an object source: the map the player stood on when the object was opened. Older addons send none.

x.description: The player's x on that map, 0 to 100.

y.description: The player's y on that map, 0 to 100.

gatherKind.description: How the object was opened, from the spell cast on it (`GATHER_KINDS`); `other` when the spell is not one the addon knows.

sourceObjectName.description: The object's name as the game showed it. Public only when 3 installs agree on it.

category.description: The quest log header the quest sits under, a zone or a category. Older addons send none.

faction.description: The faction of the character that accepted it. Never the character's name.

suggestedGroup.description: The suggested group size the quest log shows; absent for a solo quest.

tag.description: The quest tag the game reports, when it reports one.
